initial_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE final gameplay-view art concept for redesigning an existing 2D Chinese old factory/prison exercise yard.
Input images: Image 1 is CURRENT GAME/EDITOR VISUAL STYLE and the RED RECTANGLE is the TARGET AREA. Image 2 is the MASTER LAYOUT REFERENCE of this same exercise yard in the approved campus plan. They are reference images, NOT an edit target. Generate a new crisp finished environment view, using the compact horizontal master composition rather than the current tall court. Do not reproduce blur, screenshot UI or red boxes.
Camera: orthographic elevated TOP-DOWN 2D game projection, all ground grid and architectural axes screen-horizontal/vertical, exactly consistent with Image1. No diamond isometric, perspective horizon, photo, 3D dollhouse, tilted architecture or painterly cinematic camera.
Composition: full target yard is a shallow horizontal rectangle approximately 1240 world units wide by640 deep (roughly 2:1). A narrow surrounding context is visible: NORTH the existing campus boundary wall and wild outside greenery; WEST a narrow glimpse of the renovated clinic's ivory plaster/low green tile exterior; SOUTH a paved crosswalk and narrow hint of the workshop building edge; EAST a broad uninterrupted grey-green paved main route leading up toward the campus entrance. Keep east route and southern pedestrian connection open. The yard is an OUTDOOR activity space, not a roofless room enclosed by four thick standalone walls. Main area occupies most of the frame. No asset sheet, split panels, legend or annotation.
Art direction: crisp game-ready hand-painted surfaces and dark restrained outlines, quiet warm-grey/earth-grey outdoor concrete, faded dark green exercise equipment, grey-blue corrugated iron roofing, worn ochre wood benches, muted olive vegetation. Clear shapes with modest localized rust/cracks and soft upper-left daylight. Readable calm ground surfaces; no grain/noise blanket and no excessive rubble. Existing chibi art, not photoreal.
Exact arrangement derived from master:
1. CENTRAL slightly RIGHT: one compact basketball HALF-COURT, around400x330world units. One small aged cream rectangular backboard with dark rim and a dark green single support at the NORTH end, located behind the end line. Ground has faint broken offwhite rectangle, key, free-throw semicircle and a modest arc. No full basketball court, no huge centre circle or stretched vertical playing area. Court lines must not take over the whole yard.
2. WEST of court: ONE compact two-height pull-up bar group in worn dark green iron, clearly elevated horizontal bars, three upright supports with feet visibly grounded. Keep an accessible area around it. No swing, slide, gym machines or playground.
3. NORTH edge: TWO worn wooden horizontal benches, seats facing into the yard; grouped with restrained nearby shrubs and a small mature tree near the northwest corner. Avoid regularly spaced identical flowerpots.
4. SOUTH edge: TWO horizontal wooden benches facing into the yard, grouped with lower shrubs at the left/right ends, central connection to the southern walk remains clear.
5. NORTHEAST: ONE modest corrugated grey-blue metal shade/rain shelter, around280x190world units physical footprint, plain dark supports. Visible front opening and usable space below. Roof follows the same elevated orthographic projection. Under it one small old wooden crate and a simple place to sit, nothing cluttered. Do not draw a massive enclosed storage building or extra architecture.
6. EAST edge between shelter and open route: one longitudinal north-south wood bench, low shrubs grouped at upper and lower edge, opening in the middle for entry from main route. Main route is at least180worldunits wide, empty and uninterrupted.
7. SOUTHWEST edge: a compact group of two faded old metal drums and ONE actual dented metal bucket close to the bench/vegetation. Keep the central exercise area free of props. No discarded medical supplies or laundry bundle pretending to be a bucket.
8. Ground: worn broad warm grey concrete patches with sparse thin seams, few repaired areas, light dry soil collecting under benches/trees and along edges. Naturally irregular transition to dusty grass edges; do not draw a crisp separate rectangular patio outlined with a heavy border or a uniform indoor tiled floor.
9. Vegetation: limited grouped small trees, shrubs and weeds at northwestern/northeastern/southern corners. Mix ground-planted shrubs and at most two simple low concrete tree bases. Leave gaps between groups. No symmetrical park layout, huge tree canopy covering the court, tropical palms or floral landscaping.
10. Show TWO familiar fully clothed chibi orange-uniform prisoners (one in the west activity space, one near the court), and ONE dark-blue-uniform guard near the east path. Each approximately84world units tall relative to640-yard depth, same character scale as game, normal proportions for its chibi art. They illustrate scale and use, not action combat. Keep them apart from obstacles.
Important: the white rectangle text "放风院" on Image2 is a MAP LEGEND, not physical floor decor. Do NOT put giant words, rugs or plaques on ground. No HUD, toolbar, FPS, editor circles, red outlines, arrows, wayfinding dashed paths, highlighted zones, giant written labels, weapons or extra facilities.
Finish as one coherent believable final in-game environment concept, modest old prison exercise yard, compact half-court and edges supporting exercise/rest/conversation, everyday austere materials, matching game assets and scale.
final_edit_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the provided final exercise-yard concept.
Make ONLY this small basketball court correction. Preserve the entire original image composition, camera, resolution/aspect, walls, main path, clinic, workshop, benches, shelter, trees, vegetation, drums, bucket, characters, lighting and all non-court pixels as closely as possible.
Redraw ONLY the faded white basketball playing lines and reposition the basketball hoop slightly north if required:
- The existing outer playing rectangle is too wide. Narrow its width by approximately20%, keeping the court near the same centre and the lower boundary at the same general level. Do not expand height. It should be a compact half-court, with plenty of surrounding exercise/rest ground.
- The ONLY hoop is at the NORTH end, horizontally centred on the NORTH baseline. Move its ground support/base JUST OUTSIDE/ABOVE that baseline, not standing in the painted key. Keep same aged cream board, dark green stand and general size.
- Make the key a straight upright rectangle extending SOUTH from the north baseline beneath the hoop, with a modest semicircle at its southern/free-throw end.
- Replace the current off-centre curve on the RIGHT side with ONE simple symmetric three-point ARC centred on the hoop and bowing SOUTH into the court. Both arc ends meet the north-side area, mirrored left/right. No side-facing hoop geometry, centre circle, full second half, unnecessary transverse grid lines or full regular indoor sports court.
Keep worn offwhite line appearance with a few breaks. Keep the orange prisoner in the court visible. Do not add text or change any other scene elements.
